# skill: sales-copy

Use when writing a listing, a live sale script or a win-back message

# sales-copy — listings, live scripts and win-back messages for Thai sellers

> **One rule:** every claim, price and offer in the copy must be true today and approved by the owner; a banned claim or an invented discount is removed, not softened.

## Pick the part

| Job (what the user says) | Open |
|---|---|
| Writing or fixing a marketplace product listing | [references/product-listing.md](references/product-listing.md) |
| Preparing a live selling session, run sheet or host lines | [references/live-selling-script.md](references/live-selling-script.md) |
| A shop wants lapsed regular customers back | [references/win-back-customers.md](references/win-back-customers.md) |

Shared files: [references/prohibited-claims.md](references/prohibited-claims.md) (claims check for food, supplement and cosmetic items), [references/description-template.md](references/description-template.md), [references/host-lines.md](references/host-lines.md).

## Steps every part shares

1. Collect the real facts first: product, price, stock, and any licence number (อย. or เลขจดแจ้ง) for food and cosmetics. Missing facts are written `(รอยืนยัน)`, never guessed.
2. Set the price after `pricing-and-costs` and the stock after `shop-operations`, so the copy matches the numbers in the system.
3. Run the claims check in [references/prohibited-claims.md](references/prohibited-claims.md) before the copy leaves your hands.

## Check before done

- No banned claim (treat, cure, "ของแท้ 100%" without proof, "อันดับ 1", "ถูกที่สุด") and no fake countdown or stock count.
- Every price and quantity said or written matches the platform's setting.
- Win-back: contact only the shop's own list, only people with a recorded marketing consent, at most 15 per round, and nothing sent before the owner approves each message.
- Live: show only a buyer's first name or username on screen, never a full name, phone or address.
- Marketplace buyers are never messaged outside the platform.

Whole job with several steps → playbook [new-product](../superuser/references/playbook-new-product.md) or [live-session](../superuser/references/playbook-live-session.md).


## reference: description-template.md

# Description template (Thai)

Fill every line; delete a line only if it truly does not apply.

```
【ชื่อสินค้า】 <ชื่อเต็มเหมือนในหัวข้อ>

✔ จุดเด่น
• <ประโยชน์ที่ลูกค้าได้ ข้อ 1 — เป็นผลลัพธ์ ไม่ใช่สเปก>
• <ข้อ 2>
• <ข้อ 3>

📐 รายละเอียดสินค้า
• ขนาด: <กว้าง x ยาว x สูง ซม.> / ปริมาณ: <มล. หรือ กรัม>
• น้ำหนัก: <กรัม>
• วัสดุ/ส่วนประกอบ: <...>
• สี/ตัวเลือก: <ตรงกับชื่อตัวเลือกในระบบ>
• ผลิตที่: <ประเทศ> · เลข อย./เลขจดแจ้ง: <ถ้ามี>
• วันผลิต/วันหมดอายุ: <ถ้าเป็นอาหารหรือเครื่องสำอาง>

📦 ในกล่องมี
• <รายการ>

👤 เหมาะกับ
• <ใคร ใช้ทำอะไร>

ระวัง: วิธีใช้ / ข้อควรระวัง
• <คัดจากฉลาก ห้ามแต่งเพิ่ม>

🚚 การจัดส่ง
• ส่งภายใน <1–2> วันทำการหลังชำระเงิน (ตัดรอบ <เวลา>)

🔁 การคืนสินค้า
• กรุณาถ่ายวิดีโอขณะแกะกล่อง หากสินค้าเสียหายหรือไม่ตรงปก ทักแชทได้เลย
• รับคืนตามนโยบายของ <แพลตฟอร์ม>

💬 สอบถามเพิ่มเติม ทักแชทได้ <เวลาตอบแชท>
```

## Rules

- Benefits first, specs second — buyers scan the first 3 lines on a phone
- Pick one form for the whole page: the product page has no ค่ะ/ครับ (marketing register) · if the shop wants them, put them on every line that speaks to the customer, not on a single line → `human-writing` `references/thai-grammar.md` section 4, the marketing register
- Metric units; sizes in ซม., never "ประมาณฝ่ามือ"
- Copy usage and warnings from the actual label; do not add effects the label does not state
- No LINE ID, phone number or outside link in Shopee/Lazada/TikTok descriptions — against platform rules
- Return line must not promise less than the platform's own policy (see `customer-care`)

# Worked examples · product-listing

Open from SKILL.md when you need a model for a title or description bullet.

Worked example — cotton tote bag, Shopee:
`[ผ้าดี] กระเป๋าผ้า ใบใหญ่ ผ้าแคนวาส 12 ออนซ์ 38x42 ซม. มีซิป ช่องใส่โน้ตบุ๊ก 14 นิ้ว สำหรับนักศึกษา ทำงาน`

Same product, TikTok Shop:
`กระเป๋าผ้าใบใหญ่ ใส่โน้ตบุ๊กได้ มีซิป ผ้าหนา 12 ออนซ์ ผ้าดี`

Description bullets — one benefit with a number per line, not a lifestyle list:

| Weak | Strong |
|---|---|
| ไม่ว่าจะเป็นสายออกกำลังกาย สายแฟชั่น หรือสายชิล ตอบโจทย์ทุกไลฟ์สไตล์ | ซักเครื่องได้ 50 ครั้งสีไม่ตก · เนื้อผ้า 180 แกรม ใส่หน้าร้อนไม่ร้อน |


## reference: host-lines.md

# Host lines (Thai)

Fill `<...>`; say them word for word until the host is comfortable.

## Opening hook (first 3 seconds — no greeting first)
- "กระเป๋าใบนี้ใส่โน้ตบุ๊ก 14 นิ้วได้ แถมมีซิป วันนี้ในไลฟ์เหลือ <ราคา> บาทเท่านั้นค่ะ"
- "ใครผิวแห้งลอกตอนเปิดแอร์ทั้งวัน ดูตัวนี้ค่ะ เนื้อเจลซึมไว ไม่เหนอะ"
- "<20> ชิ้นสุดท้ายของล็อตนี้ ราคานี้มีแค่ในไลฟ์ค่ะ"

## Re-hook for new viewers (every 10–15 minutes)
- "ใครเพิ่งเข้ามา ตอนนี้ <สินค้า> ราคาไลฟ์ <ราคา> จากปกติ <ราคา> กดตะกร้าสีเหลือง/ปักหมุดด้านล่างได้เลยค่ะ"

## Show and prove
- Size: "ดูนะคะ วางเทียบกับมือ กว้าง <xx> ซม. สูง <xx> ซม."
- Material: "ซูมให้ดูตะเข็บค่ะ เย็บสองชั้น ดึงแรง ๆ ก็ไม่ขาด"
- Proof: "รีวิวจากคุณ <ชื่อเล่น/ยูสเซอร์> บอกว่า '<ข้อความรีวิวจริง>' ค่ะ"
- Cosmetic texture: "ทาให้ดูบนหลังมือ เนื้อบางเบา ซึมไว" — describe texture and feel, never an effect the label does not state

## Price and call to action
- "ราคาปกติ <ราคา> วันนี้ในไลฟ์ <ราคา> กดสั่งตอนนี้ ส่งพรุ่งนี้เช้าค่ะ"
- "ซื้อคู่กับ <add-on> รวม <ราคา> ประหยัดกว่าซื้อแยก <x> บาทค่ะ"
- "ใครสั่งแล้ว พิมพ์ 'สั่งแล้ว' ในคอมเมนต์ แอดมินจะเช็กให้ค่ะ"

## Flash deal
- Start: "Flash Sale เริ่มแล้ว <x> นาที <จำนวน> ชิ้นเท่านั้น ราคา <ราคา> กดเลยค่ะ"
- Midway: "เหลือ <จำนวนจริง> ชิ้น อีก <นาทีจริง> นาทีค่ะ"
- End: "หมดแล้วค่ะ ขอบคุณทุกคนนะคะ ใครไม่ทัน รอบหน้า <วัน เวลา> มีอีกค่ะ"

## Answering comments
- Use the username: "คุณ <ยูสเซอร์> ถามว่ามีสีกรมไหม มีค่ะ เหลือ <x> ใบ"
- Out of stock: "สีนี้หมดในไลฟ์แล้วค่ะ กดติดตามร้านไว้ ของเข้า <วันที่> ค่ะ"
- Off-topic or abuse: ignore on air; moderator hides it

## Close
- "ขอบคุณทุกคนที่มาดูวันนี้นะคะ ไลฟ์หน้า <วัน> <เวลา> มี <สินค้า/ดีล> ค่ะ กดติดตามไว้ จะได้แจ้งเตือนค่ะ"

## Never say
- "รักษา", "หายขาด", "เห็นผลใน 7 วัน", "ขาวถาวร", "ลดน้ำหนักได้ <x> โล"
- "หมดแล้ว" when stock remains, or a countdown that resets
- A competitor's name or "ของร้านอื่นปลอม"


## reference: keyword-and-photos.md

# Keyword research and photo checklist

Moved from `SKILL.md`. Open at workflow step 2 (keywords) and step 4 (photos).

## Keyword research via search suggestions

1. Open the buyer app (not Seller Centre), logged out or in incognito
2. Type the product's plain Thai word, e.g. `กระเป๋าผ้า` — write down every suggestion in the drop-down
3. Add one word at a time: `กระเป๋าผ้า ใบใหญ่`, `กระเป๋าผ้า มินิมอล` — the suggestions are what buyers actually type
4. Repeat in English and in the transliteration buyers use (`tote bag`, `โท้ทแบค`)
5. Search the top 3 suggestions; open the first 5 best-selling listings and note the words in their titles
6. Keep a sheet: keyword · platform · in suggestions (Y/N) · in top-seller titles (count)
7. TikTok Shop: also check the TikTok app search suggestions and the hashtags on the top videos

Main keyword = appears in suggestions **and** in most top-seller titles. Do not use competitor brand names — it breaks every platform's listing rules.

## Photo checklist

- [ ] Photo 1: product only, white or plain background, product fills 70–85% of frame, no text over the product
- [ ] Square 1:1, at least 800 x 800 px; 1024 x 1024 or larger preferred — check each platform's current minimum (รอยืนยัน)
- [ ] Photo 2: in use / on a person / in a room — shows scale
- [ ] Photo 3: size with ruler or hand; dimensions written on the image
- [ ] Photo 4: close-up of material, stitching, or the label with เลข อย.
- [ ] Photo 5: every colour/variant side by side, labelled exactly as the variant names
- [ ] Photo 6: what is in the box
- [ ] Photo 7–9: one benefit per Thai text card, or a size chart
- [ ] Video 10–60 s — expected in practice on TikTok Shop
- [ ] No other shop's watermark, no stock photo without rights, no before/after body photos for cosmetics or slimming
- [ ] Same main photo on every platform so returning buyers recognise it

Image sizes per platform and banner formats → `graphic-design` `campaign-set` (if installed).


## reference: live-selling-script.md

<!-- merged from skill `live-selling-script` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when preparing a live selling session -->
# Live Selling Script

## 0 · Look for an existing format first (every time)

Before using the structure or templates in this file, check whether the user, the client or the project already has its own format:

- **What to look at:** the shop's earlier lives: sales per segment, when the viewer count peaked, which products sold well (from the platform's live statistics page) · the live length the shop can really sustain · 2–3 lives from shops in the same category, to see how they open and close deals
- **Result:** if found, use it (headings, order, field names, running numbers) and say in the reply which file the format came from. If not found, use the template in this file as the fallback and say that no existing format was found
- **Every format still needs:** the 60-minute run sheet below is the fallback · adjust the round length and deal rhythm to the shop's numbers · the legal rules in Compliance apply to every format

## Workflow

1. **Collect**: platform, length, host, backstage person, product list (normal price, live price, stock allocated to the live), shipping offer, vouchers already set
2. **Allocate stock** for the live in `shop-operations` and set the live prices and vouchers in Seller Centre **before** going live
3. **Pick the hero product** (best seller or best deal) and 1–2 add-ons that pair with it; choose flash-deal items with the knapsack rule below
4. **Build the run sheet** (template below): 10–15 minute loops
5. **Write host lines** from [host lines](host-lines.md) — hook, proof, price, call to action per product
6. **Compliance pass** — every claim against `product-listing.md` prohibited claims; every price on air = price in the system
7. **Rehearse 5 minutes** with the backstage person: who pins products, who answers comments, who watches stock
8. **After the live**: record viewers, peak viewers, orders, sales, top question; 3 lessons for next time

## Run sheet — 60 minutes, two products + one flash deal

| Time | Segment | Host does | Backstage does |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:03 | Hook | Hero product in hand, the deal in one line, no greetings first | Pin hero product |
| 0:03–0:10 | Hero rundown | Show, demo, size/texture close-up, price, call to action (CTA) | Answer size/stock comments by name |
| 0:10–0:12 | Social proof | Read 2 real reviews, show sales count | Post voucher code in comments |
| 0:12–0:20 | Add-on product | Pair with hero ("ใช้คู่กับ..."), bundle price, CTA | Switch pinned product |
| 0:20–0:25 | **Flash deal #1** | Countdown 5 min, fixed units ("20 ชิ้นเท่านั้น") | Activate flash price, call out units left honestly |
| 0:25–0:27 | Re-hook | Restate the deal for new viewers | Re-pin hero |
| 0:27–0:45 | Loop 2 | Repeat hero + add-on with new angles (another colour, Q&A) | Note top questions |
| 0:45–0:50 | **Flash deal #2** (smaller, different SKU) | Same pattern | Same |
| 0:50–0:57 | Q&A + recap | Answer saved questions, recap all prices | Pin best seller |
| 0:57–1:00 | Close | Last call, next live date and time | Screenshot results |

Flash-deal rules of thumb: first deal after viewers have built up (around minute 15–25), not at minute 0; 3–10 minute window; quantity small enough to sell out (10–20% of the live allocation) so "หมดแล้ว" is true; never a fake countdown.

## Pick flash-deal items by expected profit (ตัดสินด้วยตัวเลข)

Use `decision-desk/decision-scoring` command `knapsack` (`node decide.mjs knapsack <file.json>`; up to 20 items it finds the true best set).

| Part | Rule |
|---|---|
| Hard rules first | live price above the campaign floor (`pricing-and-costs`) · live stock covers the units you will announce · no item with a banned claim (`product-listing.md`) |
| Budget | minutes of flash-deal slots in the run sheet (e.g. 2 deals x 5 min = 10), or units of live stock when stock is the limit. One budget per run |
| Cost of an item | minutes it takes on air (demo + countdown + CTA) |
| Value of an item | expected profit in baht = margin per unit x expected units sold. Expected units come from this shop's last live; no past live → write `(รอยืนยัน)` and use the lowest number you would accept |
| Must-keep | the hero product: `"must": true`, so it stays in the set whatever the numbers say |

Read the line "ชุดรองลงมา" in the result (items, total value, gap from the best set in %; shown only when there are 20 items or fewer). If the gap is under 10% (starting value, not yet measured), the host picks by what fits the story of the live.

## Backstage checklist

- [ ] Live prices, vouchers and flash deal set and tested in a test order view
- [ ] Stock allocation entered; other channels reduced (`shop-operations`)
- [ ] Phone on charger, stable Wi-Fi or 5G, ring light, clean background with the shop name
- [ ] Products in run-sheet order on the table, price cards written large
- [ ] Comment moderator ready; banned-word list set (competitor names, abuse)
- [ ] Thumbnail and teaser posted 1–3 hours before (`graphic-design` `campaign-set` (if installed))

## Compliance

- Claims: the same อย. (สำนักงานคณะกรรมการอาหารและยา) / สคบ. (สำนักงานคณะกรรมการคุ้มครองผู้บริโภค) rules as listings — no treat/cure, no "เห็นผลใน 7 วัน", no before/after body shots (`product-listing.md` [prohibited claims](../../sales-copy/references/prohibited-claims.md))
- Price: "ลดจาก X" only if X was a real recent selling price; spoken price must equal the system price
- Scarcity: units left and time left must be true — false urgency is misleading advertising
- Giveaways by draw (จับรางวัล/ชิงโชค) may need a permit under the gambling law; a giveaway to everyone who buys (ของแถมทุกออเดอร์) usually does not — check with the local district office before a draw (รอยืนยัน)
- Alcohol: selling alcoholic drinks through electronic channels has been banned since Dec 2020 (รอยืนยัน current status); tobacco and e-cigarettes cannot be sold
- Never show a buyer's full name, phone or address on screen when reading orders aloud — first name or username only

## เรียกเป็นคำสั่ง

`/e-commerce:sales-copy <platform> <length in minutes> <products with price and stock>`

Run `sales-copy` with the `live-seller` agent for: **the user's request**

Output the minute-by-minute run sheet and the host lines in Thai. Flag any product claim that fails the prohibited-claims check.


## reference: product-listing.md

<!-- merged from skill `product-listing` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when writing or fixing a marketplace product listing -->
# Product Listing (Thai marketplaces)

## Workflow

1. **Collect facts** — product name, brand, model, size/volume/weight, colour/variants, material, who it is for, price, stock, เลข อย. (สำนักงานคณะกรรมการอาหารและยา) or เลขจดแจ้ง if food or cosmetic
2. **Keyword research** (10 minutes, free) — buyer-app search suggestions, steps in [references/keyword-and-photos.md](keyword-and-photos.md); pick 1 main keyword (in suggestions **and** most top-seller titles) + 3–5 supporting; never a competitor brand name
3. **Title** — apply the platform formula in the table; stay inside the length limit
4. **Photos** — run the photo checklist in the same reference file (photo 1 on a plain background, 1:1 at least 800 x 800 px, same main photo on every platform)
5. **Description** — fill [the template](description-template.md)
6. **Claims check** — food, supplement, cosmetic, "health" items: run [prohibited claims](prohibited-claims.md) and delete every hit
7. **Variants and Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)** — name SKUs per `shop-operations` before publishing, so stock syncs later
8. **Price** — set after `pricing-and-costs`, never before

## Title formulas

| Platform | Formula | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Shopee | `[แบรนด์] + [คำค้นหลัก] + [รุ่น/สเปก] + [ขนาด/จำนวน] + [จุดเด่น 1–2] + [เหมาะกับ]` | Main keyword in the first ~40 characters (what shows in the grid); limit about 120 characters (รอยืนยัน) |
| Lazada | `[แบรนด์] + [ชื่อสินค้า/คำค้นหลัก] + [รุ่น] + [สเปกสำคัญ] + [ขนาด/สี]` | Brand field must match the brand in the title; no promo words in title; limit (รอยืนยัน) |
| TikTok Shop | `[คำค้นหลัก] + [จุดเด่นที่เห็นในคลิป] + [ขนาด/จำนวน] + [แบรนด์]` | Buyers arrive from video, so match the words said in the clip; limit (รอยืนยัน) |
| LINE shop / MyShop | `[ชื่อสินค้าสั้น] + [ขนาด] + [ราคาโปร]` | Customers already know the shop; clarity beats keywords |
| Facebook post | Line 1 = benefit + price; line 2 = how to order | Search matters little; the first 2 lines decide the click |

Never in a title: `ถูกที่สุด`, `อันดับ 1`, `ของแท้ 100%` without proof, emoji runs, ALL CAPS, `ส่งฟรี` (use the shipping setting instead), words from another category to catch traffic.

Worked title examples (Shopee and TikTok Shop tote bag) and weak vs strong description bullets: [references/examples.md](examples.md). Description bullets: one benefit with a number per line, not a lifestyle list.

## Diagnose a listing that does not sell

Read the listing's own numbers in Seller Centre (views or impressions, click rate, orders) before touching the copy. The ratio tells which half is broken:

| Numbers | Problem | Fix in this order |
|---|---|---|
| Few views | Visibility — buyers never see it | Main keyword in the first 40 characters · true category · price inside the range of the top 5 results · stock not 0 · ads or voucher only after these |
| Views fine, few orders | Conversion — seen, not chosen | First photo on plain background · price and shipping cost shown · size chart or dimensions · rating and review count · description answers the top 3 chat questions |
| Orders fine, rating falls | Product or packing, not the listing | `customer-care`, then fix the claim that over-promised |

Rank the actions: do first the one that touches every buyer for the least work (title and first photo beat a rewritten description), 1 change per 3–7 days so the numbers show what worked.

## Audit the whole shop

When the owner asks to "check all listings" or a batch of listings needs fixing, score every listing on the same 4 checks, so the result is a list, not a pile of opinions:

| Check | Fails when |
|---|---|
| Attributes missing | the platform's attribute fields (brand, material, size, model, warranty, เลข อย.) are blank or "อื่น ๆ" |
| Description too thin to be found | under about 3 lines, or the main keyword appears nowhere outside the title |
| Category conflicts with the product | the chosen category does not match the title or attributes (also changes the commission rate) |
| Photos missing for this product type | no size or label photo where buyers expect one (`graphic-design:marketplace-product-images`, if installed) |

1. Sort by impact: listings that sell well but fail checks come first, then the rest by views.
2. Group the fixes by the kind of fix (for example "38 listings lack material"), so the owner approves 1 pattern, not 38 edits.
3. Fix 1–2 listings as samples and get the owner's yes before doing the rest of the group.
4. Anything else found on the way (a wrong price, a banned claim) is reported as a separate item. Do not fix it quietly inside the batch.

## Rules

- **Never guess an attribute.** Material, size, model, ingredients and warranty come only from the supplier's spec sheet, the label, or what the owner said this session. "Probably cotton" stays blank and becomes a question to the owner, one field at a time. Praise from reviews ("ผ้านุ่มมาก") never turns into a claim in the description; it also keeps you clear of the prohibited claims above
- One listing = one product; variants for colour/size only, never different products under one listing
- Stock number comes from the master sheet (`shop-operations`), never typed from memory
- Category must be the true category — a wrong category changes the commission rate and risks takedown
- Food, supplements, cosmetics: show เลขสารบบอาหาร or เลขที่ใบรับจดแจ้ง in the description and a photo of the label; check the number at oryor.com before reselling someone else's product
- Keep a copy of every final title and description in a sheet; platform edits sometimes get lost

## Not an AI look

Use real product photos — no AI-generated people and no text baked into images.

## Related

- `pricing-and-costs`, `shop-operations`, `live-selling-script.md` (the same claims rules apply on air)
- `graphic-design` `marketplace-product-images` (if installed) — product photo sizes, white background, rejected images · banner and post sizes → `campaign-set`
- `line-oa` — when the LINE shop is the channel

## เรียกเป็นคำสั่ง

`/e-commerce:sales-copy <product> <platform(s)> [key features, price, category]`

Run `sales-copy` with the `shop-manager` agent for: **the user's request**

Produce one title per platform inside its length limit, the description from the template, and the photo checklist. For food, supplements or cosmetics, run the prohibited-claims check and list every phrase removed.


## reference: prohibited-claims.md

# Prohibited and risky claims — food, supplements, cosmetics

General information, not legal advice. Advertising rules come from สำนักงานคณะกรรมการอาหารและยา (อย., Thai Food and Drug Administration) under พ.ร.บ.อาหาร พ.ศ. 2522 and พ.ร.บ.เครื่องสำอาง พ.ศ. 2558, and from สำนักงานคณะกรรมการคุ้มครองผู้บริโภค (สคบ., Office of the Consumer Protection Board) under พ.ร.บ.คุ้มครองผู้บริโภค พ.ศ. 2522 for false or exaggerated advertising generally. When unsure, ask อย. (สายด่วน 1556) before posting.

## Never write (any product)

| Phrase type | Examples | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Treats / cures / prevents disease | รักษา, หายขาด, ป้องกันโรค, ลดเบาหวาน, ลดความดัน, ต้านมะเร็ง | Medical claim — only registered medicines may claim this |
| Instant or time-bound results | เห็นผลทันที, เห็นผลใน 7 วัน, การันตีผล 100% | อย. treats time-bound and guaranteed results as misleading |
| Superlatives without proof | ดีที่สุด, อันดับ 1, ปลอดภัย 100%, ไม่มีผลข้างเคียง | Unprovable; สคบ. treats as exaggeration |
| Borrowed authority | แพทย์แนะนำ, อย. รับรองสรรพคุณ, ผ่านการทดลองทางคลินิก (without a real study) | The อย. number registers the product, not the advertising claim |
| Before/after body photos | ภาพก่อน-หลัง ผอม/ขาว | Treated as an exaggerated effect |

## Food and dietary supplements (ผลิตภัณฑ์เสริมอาหาร)

- Never: ลดน้ำหนัก, เผาผลาญไขมัน, ลดพุง, กระชับสัดส่วน, เพิ่มสมรรถภาพทางเพศ, เพิ่มความสูง, ผิวขาว, ล้างสารพิษ, บำรุงตับ/ไต as a treatment
- Advertising food benefits generally needs a separate advertising permit (ใบอนุญาตโฆษณา, ฆอ.) — the food number alone does not cover advertising; exact scope (รอยืนยัน) at fda.moph.go.th
- Show เลขสารบบอาหาร exactly as on the label; check it at oryor.com or the อย. app

## Cosmetics (เครื่องสำอาง)

- A cosmetic may claim to clean, beautify, perfume or protect skin and hair — not to change the body's structure or function
- Never: ขาวถาวร, ลบฝ้า กระ หายขาด, รักษาสิว, ปลูกผม, ยกกระชับแทนการผ่าตัด, ลดริ้วรอยถาวร, ฆ่าเชื้อโรค, สลายไขมัน
- Show เลขที่ใบรับจดแจ้ง and check it in the อย. database before reselling
- A quoted customer review may not state an effect the seller itself could not legally claim

## Safe rewrites

| Risky | Safer |
|---|---|
| ขาวใน 7 วัน | ช่วยให้ผิวดูกระจ่างใส ชุ่มชื้น |
| รักษาสิว | ทำความสะอาดผิวหน้าอย่างอ่อนโยน เหมาะกับผิวที่เป็นสิวง่าย |
| ลดน้ำหนัก 5 โล | ใยอาหารสูง ช่วยให้อิ่มนาน (only if the label states it) |
| ปลอดภัย 100% | จดแจ้งกับ อย. เลขที่ ... |
| ดีที่สุดในไทย | ขายแล้วกว่า <ตัวเลขจริง> ชิ้น (keep the proof) |

## Check before posting

- [ ] Every effect in the copy appears on the approved label
- [ ] No disease, body-shape, permanent-whitening or time-bound promise
- [ ] เลข อย./เลขจดแจ้ง shown and checked
- [ ] No before/after body photo
- [ ] Live script and video captions use the same safe wording (`live-selling-script.md`)

Last checked 2026-10-06 · Sources: https://www.fda.moph.go.th · https://www.thansettakij.com/health-wellness/health/665172 · ฆอ. permit scope (รอยืนยัน)

## reference: win-back-customers.md

<!-- merged from skill `win-back-customers` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when a shop wants lapsed regular customers back -->
# Win Back Customers

Finds regular customers who stopped buying, ranks them by what they used to spend, and drafts one message per person that the owner approves before it goes out.

> **One rule:** only contact people on the shop's own list who agreed to hear from it. Marketplace buyers belong to the platform; never message them outside it.

## Use when / not when

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| "ลูกค้าประจำหายไปหลายคน", sales from repeat buyers dropping, a slow month | this skill |
| Message to all LINE OA friends or a segment of 50+ | `line-oa` |
| Answer a customer who wrote first | `customer-care` |
| Low reviews by theme | `customer-care`, monthly review |
| Consent, privacy notice, opt-out records | `pdpa-workflow` |

## Who may be contacted

1. **Marketplace buyers (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop) are out of scope.** Their contact data belongs to the platform, and moving them to LINE or paying outside the platform breaks platform rules (`customer-care`, Rules). Use the platform's own follower vouchers instead.
2. **The shop's own list only**: LINE OA friends who ordered through LINE, Facebook page buyers, walk-in members, website customers.
3. **A marketing message needs a consent record**: send only to people with a recorded marketing consent (`pdpa-workflow` section 2, Marketing row), and put a way to stop in every message as well. An opt-out line alone is not a basis. No record of consent → do not send; ask the owner first. Whether legitimate interest can cover past buyers of the shop is (รอยืนยัน with a lawyer); until then, treat it as no.
4. **LINE push messages use quota** per recipient (`line-oa` → `references/line-broadcast.md` section 1). 15 people is cheap; still count it.

## Steps

1. **Load the order history** (date, customer, amount, items) for at least 12 months.
2. **Find each customer's own rhythm**: the median days between their orders. Only customers with 3 or more orders have a rhythm.
3. **Lapsed** = days since the last order is more than 2 × their own median gap. A customer who buys every 20 days and has been gone 45 days is lapsed; one who buys every 90 days and has been gone 45 days is not. Do not use one shop-wide cut-off.
4. **Rank** lapsed customers by what they spent in the last 12 months before they stopped. Put first anyone who left a low review or a complaint and then stopped buying; that is the clearest sign something went wrong.
5. **Take at most 15 per round.** More than that and the messages become a broadcast.
6. **Draft one message per person** that names their real history ("ครีมกันแดดสูตรเดิมที่สั่งประจำ") and, if they complained, what changed since. Any offer must be one the owner already runs or approves now; never invent a discount. Each message ends with how to stop receiving messages.
7. **The owner approves each message** before sending. Log who was contacted, the date, and whether they bought within 30 days, so the next round knows what worked.

The 2 × median-gap line and the 15-person cap are starting values, not measured on Thai shops.

## Check before handing over

1. Every person on the list came from the shop's own channels and has a recorded marketing consent.
2. Lapsed is based on each person's own gap, not a shop-wide number.
3. No more than 15 people; each message names real history and ends with a way to stop receiving messages.
4. No offer that the owner has not approved; nothing sent before approval.

- [`worked-example.md`](worked-example.md) — open for a worked example with a draft message

## reference: worked-example.md

# Worked example

Own LINE shop, 12 months of orders (illustrative). คุณเอ: 9 orders, median gap 21 days, last order 58 days ago, ฿6,300 in 12 months, left a 2-star chat complaint about a leaking bottle 60 days ago → lapsed (58 > 42), ranked first. คุณบี: 3 orders, gap 95 days, last order 70 days ago → not lapsed.

Draft for คุณเอ (owner approves first):
> สวัสดีค่ะคุณเอ ร้าน{ร้าน}ค่ะ ครั้งก่อนขวดเซรั่มที่ส่งไปรั่ว ต้องขออภัยอีกครั้งนะคะ ตอนนี้ร้านเปลี่ยนเป็นขวดฝาล็อกและห่อกันกระแทก 2 ชั้นแล้วค่ะ ถ้าจะสั่งสูตรเดิมอีก ทักมาได้เลยนะคะ (ไม่อยากรับข้อความจากร้าน พิมพ์ "หยุด" ได้เลยค่ะ)
